description: The recent bulk acts on a project's sprints, newest first — each one SET OF CHANGES that rollback_sprint_change undoes in one call: 'kind' delete (a sprint deleted into the trash, its issues to the backlog), complete (a sprint completed, its unfinished issues moved out) move (several issues put into a sprint or the backlog at once — set_issues_sprint, the board's «Sprint ▾») or rebuild (a disbanded sprint rebuilt from its issues' history — rebuild_sprint); the 'sprint', 'at', 'by', 'via' (the door: ui, api, mcp, agent), 'issues' (how many), 'keys' (those of projects you can open; 'hidden' counts the rest), 'rolledBack' (when and by whom, once undone) and 'canRollback'. Any member may read it.
